details: Package name `@solana-labs/web3js` closely resembles the official Solana JavaScript SDK published as `@solana/web3.js`. The published bundle (`lib/index.cjs.js`, `lib/index.esm.js`) contains `fetch`/`POST`/`https.get` and `ping` references typical of an RPC client library, and these patterns alone do not confirm malicious intent — the official SDK includes similar networking primitives. However, the scope substitution (`@solana-labs` instead of `@solana`) is a recognized confusion pattern against a high-traffic ecosystem package, and tracing of the bundled code did not complete enough to verify whether the network destinations and command paths are limited to documented Solana RPC endpoints or include attacker-controlled hosts. Routing to human review to confirm publisher legitimacy and to inspect whether the bundled `fetch`/`https.get` targets are user-supplied RPC URLs (legitimate) versus hardcoded third-party destinations (exfiltration).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
